title: Larson abduction near Beaver, North Dakota

tellings.quote: >> She she was abducted. She was going to uh an appointment in Bismar. So, she's going from Fargo to Bismar and then just outside of Beaver, North Dakota. This is where the abduction took place

plain: In 1975 a woman named Larson was reportedly abducted, in the UFO sense of being taken by non-human beings, while driving from Fargo to an appointment in Bismarck, just outside Beaver, North Dakota. A researcher named Grant Cameron tells the story to Michels and links it to the tabloid National Enquirer, without naming a firsthand source.
